context: This criteria evaluates whether the solution correctly uses the request package's cookie jar functionality to create, store, and automatically transmit cookies across multiple requests.

checklist.name: Jar creation
checklist.description: Creates a cookie jar using request.jar()

checklist.name: Jar attachment
checklist.description: Attaches the jar to requests using the jar option

checklist.name: Automatic storage
checklist.description: Relies on automatic cookie storage from Set-Cookie response headers

checklist.name: Cookie persistence
checklist.description: Uses the same jar instance across multiple requests to maintain session state

checklist.name: Cookie access
checklist.description: Uses jar methods like getCookies() or getCookieString() to retrieve stored cookies
